tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer role. With over 5 years of specialized experience designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise e-commerce solutions for global brands such as Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, and Spring.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub.

bullets.label: Platform Optimization & Support
bullets.text: Authored FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and Order Management (OMS) configurations, while executing CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked in agile environments across international teams, translating complex business requirements into robust technical solutions and performing rigorous code reviews.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on December 15, 2026. I am available to start from December 16, 2026, and welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise aligns with your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich auf die Position als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer. Als erfahrene Softwareentwicklerin mit über fünf Jahren Praxis in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, Spring und SAP Commerce Cloud mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Backend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement.

bullets.label: REST-Schnittstellen
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services sowie Anpassung von Interceptors, Populators und Converters für reibungslose Datenflüsse zwischen PIM, ERP und MDM.

bullets.label: Plattform & Betrieb
bullets.text: Erstellung von FlexibleSearch-Abfragen, Cronjobs, Impex-Skripten und Order Management (OMS) sowie Durchführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen auf CCv2.

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Erfolgreiche Mitarbeit in agilen Teams, Anforderungsanalyse mit Business-Stakeholdern und Durchführung von Code Reviews zur Sicherung der Codequalität.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026. Ein Eintritt ist ab dem 16.12.2026 möglich. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I want to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to your innovative e-commerce projects. Your technical scope and agile environment perfectly match my background in delivering scalable Java and Spring solutions, robust API integrations, and high-performance enterprise platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud experience, deep Java/Spring expertise, and a proven track-record in building scalable e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java/Spring experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect regarding your developer opening. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on Dec 16, 2026. Let's talk!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and SAP Commerce Cloud.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on December 16, 2026, following my notice period.

I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
